notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 39 BLACKJACK
notes.content:
ZONE 4 Update – Soul Blackjack & Visual Improvements!

A major new feature is here:
You can now play BLACKJACK using SOULS in ZONE 4! Just head to the new "Sexy Cat" bar building to try it out.
・Wager your souls
・Low or High-stakes gameplay
・Rules can be read in-game — quick and easy to learn!

If players enjoy this, more games could be added in future updates.
💬 Share your thoughts via Steam Reviews or the Discussion page!

🎨 Visual Update
The blood and water art has been simplified for a cleaner, sharper look.

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.4 SPIN&WIN+
notes.content:
New Update Summary:

・New Roulette-Like Feature: Introducing Netherspin, a game where you can win prizes with every spin for just 50 Sin Coins. (at Mr.Pumpkin's)
・New Starting Card: SLICE N DICE: Now available in exchange for one of the two CHAINSAW cards.
・Lore Updates: Two new lore notes added, one regarding Sin Coins and another from James (Note: "Gamble Coins" have been renamed to "Sin Coins").
・Icon Update: The grilled fish icon has been significantly altered to avoid resembling raw fish.
・BBQ Quantity Display: The BBQ quantity is now shown before the image, instead of after.
・Animation Enhancements: Various animation improvements, such as a more pronounced burp effect for SCREAMSODA.

・Bug Fix: TRINGTRING now has a 100% hit rate as stated on the card (previously 95%).

Enjoy!
More updates coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.3 SLOT MACHINE+
notes.content:
New Update Summary:

・Added new Slot Machine Gambling System.
・Introducing Mr. Pumpkin as shopkeeper.
・Mr. Pumpkin appears in Zones 1, 3, and 6 (every 2nd map), selling two consistent items for now.
・Coins can now be found randomly inside some houses.

How the Portable Slot Machine works:
- Select "portable slot machine" item from inventory
- Your current total coins are visible here
- Place a 10-coin bet per row and spin
- Matching symbols from the far left results in a win
- Winnings are calculated as 10× the chart number
- A detailed guide will be added in a future update

・Card "TRINKTRINK" base DMG increased from 7 to 9 for a stronger start
・Improved Sin Cards description text sorting for some cards

Why is Mr.Pumpkin's shop important? It’s the first step toward buying and selling items, cards, and raw materials. A more advanced purchase menu is also in development.

More updates coming soon! :)

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.1
notes.content:
Update Summary:

・New Starting Card: BLOODBOAT now available! Set sail for battle with a powerful new beginning
・New Lore Pages have been written. Soon you'll be able to find them scattered throughout the Netherworld and gain bonus EXP!
・Level-Up Stat Adjustment: HP gain per level has been reduced from 10 to 5, and MP from 50 to 10. Balance your build strategically using the new Skilltree! More unlockable skills coming
・Balance Update: The "GEORGE" card now dodges 50% damage (previously 80%), for better late-game fairness
・Bug Fix: Resolved an error when exiting the skilltree while another menu was open
・Battle Background Music added to intensify the Zone 2 "boss" fight!

More updates coming!

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38 [Skilltree]
notes.content:
New Features in This Update:

・Basic SKILLTREE!
Players naturally gain HP and MP with each level-up. In addition to this, you can now allocate skill points to enhance your stats. This update also introduces a new on-screen button for easy access. Please note that some battles have been rebalanced to account for these changes.

Future updates will include additional stats, cards, items, and more!

Gameplay Balancing Changes Due to Skill Tree Stats:
・Mine Gold HP Cost: Adjusted from -5 HP to -10 HP (with a small chance to receive more than 1 gold)
・Enemy FLAYER [Level 6]: One of its attacks has been increased by 30%
・Enemy SHALOM [Level 4]: The Life Drain and HP Recovery abilities have been enhanced

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
・New Battle Music added.
・Card: Poison card "Vommy" from 5% to 3% damage.
・Card: Poison card "Positive" from 8% to 5% damage.
・Only different poison cards can stack damage each turn.
・Portable BBQ item has "nevermind" option to close quantity window.

I plan to add more content and zones, and the poison cards were a bit overpowered, as they could easily wipe out bosses and high HP enemies later on.

Thank you!
